user.title: Connect Google Classroom
user.description: Enter the child's dashboard name. The child will then sign in to their own Google account and approve two read-only Classroom permissions.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Google Classroom
reauth_confirm.description: Google no longer accepts this child's Classroom authorization. Continue to reconnect the same child's account.

error.invalid_child_name: Enter a child name between 1 and 64 characters.

abort.already_configured: This child name or Google Classroom account is already connected.
abort.cannot_connect: Google Classroom could not be checked. Try again in a moment.
abort.identity_unavailable: Google Classroom cannot confirm this account until the school has assigned it some coursework. Try again after coursework appears.
abort.invalid_auth: Google did not provide a valid Classroom authorization.
abort.invalid_child_name: The child name was not retained. Start the setup again.
abort.missing_scopes: Google did not grant exactly the two required read-only Classroom permissions.
abort.reauth_account_mismatch: The selected Google account does not match the account originally connected for this child.

application_credentials.description: Create an OAuth client in the [Google Cloud console]({console_url}), enable the Google Classroom API, and add Home Assistant's redirect URI to that client.
